items.title: Barry Kernfeld interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 16, 2020
items.q: There was this great New York City exhibit on Rembrandt... I’m thinking well maybe every generation gets the jazz that it deserves.

ctx.x: How does that make you feel?

Well as I said, I regret that I wasn’t a whole bunch older to have experienced that stuff in the clubs, but how does that make me feel? There was this great New York City exhibit on Rembrandt and all the disputes about what he painted and what he didn’t paint, and this really cynical thing up on the wall, it said, “Every generation gets the Rembrandt that it deserves.” And I’m thinking well maybe every generation gets the jazz that it deserves. It’s just what we are. It’s not a choice that we can make. I just…
